title: Reintroduce color accents into the app theme (less bland UI)

requirements.text: Update the app’s global theme tokens to reintroduce a subtle, cohesive color accent (not overly saturated) across light and dark themes by adjusting the existing CSS variables in frontend/src/index.css (e.g., background/surface tinting, accent/muted/secondary/ring/border harmony) while preserving readable contrast and the existing Tailwind token mapping.

quotes: This version is a little too bland. I prefered when there was a touch of color in the visual layout of the app. Can you redo that please?

acceptanceCriteria: In light mode and dark mode, the UI surfaces (page background, cards, muted panels) show a subtle color tint rather than appearing purely gray/white.
Primary and ring colors feel consistent with the rest of the palette (no clashing accents), and focus rings remain clearly visible.
Text contrast remains readable across header, cards, muted panels, and buttons (no low-contrast body text on tinted surfaces).
No user-facing text is changed as part of the theme-token update.

requirements.text: Apply the refreshed color accents consistently across the main app shell by updating layout styling in frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx (e.g., header/background treatment and main container backdrop) so the app looks more vibrant without changing navigation behavior or layout structure.

quotes: I prefered when there was a touch of color in the visual layout of the app. Can you redo that please?

acceptanceCriteria: The header and main page background visually reflect the updated accent palette (for example, subtle gradient, tinted backdrop, or accent border), while keeping the same controls and placement.
All existing header buttons (“Storefront”, “Instructions”, “Preview”, “Export”, auth button) continue to function and remain accessible with clear hover/focus states.
No changes to routing/view-state logic; this is purely visual styling.

requirements.text: Refresh key screen surfaces to pick up the updated accent palette (without changing features): ensure ExportScreen, UnifiedPreviewScreen, StorefrontScreen, StorefrontProductCard, and ProductEditor use consistent accented surface treatments (e.g., muted panels, card hover/focus states, section dividers) that align with the new theme and reduce the “bland” look.

quotes: This version is a little too bland.

acceptanceCriteria: Export screen bundle cards, instructions panel, and primary actions visually show subtle color accents consistent with the global theme.
Unified Preview cards and “Show more/less” affordances retain current behavior and empty states, but look more visually lively via the updated palette.
Storefront grid/cards retain current structure and behavior, while the cards and CTA feel more color-accented and less monochrome.
Product Editor retains current form structure and behavior; section styling and interactive states reflect the updated palette.
No new screens, no new actions, and no copy changes are introduced in these updates.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all user-facing text in English.
Do not change existing app functionality, navigation/view-state flow, generation logic, or download behavior; this request is visual/theme-only.
nonGoals: Adding new features or screens related to theming (e.g., a user-selectable theme picker).
Changing product generation/export logic, filenames, or backend APIs.
Introducing new third-party UI libraries beyond the existing stack.
